_comment: Which key feeds which action. Key names are Bevy's KeyCode names. Axes: z is back (W is negative). deadzone (0..1) and curve apply to analog sources only (the pad, the virtual-joystick mouse); keyboard keys are digital. The same key may serve several actions. Gamepad or joystick: buttons as "Pad:<GamepadButton>" (raw: "Pad:Button<n>"), an axis per action as "pad": "<GamepadAxis>" ("-" in front inverts, raw HOTAS axes: "Axis<n>"). turn_pitch and turn_yaw are stick only; on foot the stick turns the view at pad.look_rate_deg. landing_mode: the axis model's landing mode, TODO(initiator): the key (K for now). turn_cap: A/B switch for the axis model's G-safety turn cap (#118). camera_fx: the camera shake, spring lag and G field of view on or off (#148, #149). mouse.ship_mode: "vjoy" (the mouse moves a virtual stick; ship_sensitivity is radians of stick offset per pixel) or "direct" (radians of turn per pixel).
